provides: Referral codes, attribution and rewards. Every member gets one personal code (minted lazily, collision-proof; vanity codes by policy) and a share link; staff issue campaign codes with a window and an attribution cap. A visitor's client stores the code on the first visit and claims it right after sign-up: the account is attributed once (unique constraint, first touch wins), self-referral, old accounts, stale captures and closed or used-up campaign codes are refused, and opt-in guards (same device, duplicate contact, custom) can refuse a claim with a recorded reason. Reward rules fire on facts — sign-up (user.signed_up), the first qualifying order or the Nth order (orders.order.placed) — for the referrer, the referee or both, with caps per referrer per rolling period and budgets counted under a lock on the rule row. The reward ledger is idempotent per (rule, attribution, trigger, role), holds order rewards for a period, rejects them when the order is cancelled during the hold and reverses them after it. Rewards are paid by a strategy that calls the paying brick by comm Function (billing_credit, promo_code) or just records them (noop); the module never imports auth, orders, billing or promotions.

gates.behavior: off: PATCH me/code/ answers error.403.vanity_code_not_allowed; staff/users: it replaces the primary code (shape and reserved words checked, at most VANITY_MAX_CHANGES).

curated.summary: off (default): every member keeps the code minted for them. staff: staff accounts may choose one. users: every signed-in member may choose one (guests never). A replaced code keeps working for links already shared. Values: off, staff, users.

gates.behavior: true: POST claim/ answers error.403.claim_requires_account to a guest session; false: guests claim like anyone else.

curated.summary: false (default): a guest session may claim a code; the claim follows the guest into its account. true: only signed-in members can claim. Values: true, false.

gates.behavior: Order rewards are created pending with hold_until = now + HOLD_DAYS (a rule's hold_days overrides); the beat grants them after; a cancel during the hold rejects them.

curated.summary: How long a reward earned by an order waits before it is paid (default 14), so a cancelled or returned order earns nothing. Sign-up rewards are paid at once unless a rule says otherwise. Values: 0 to 365.
curated.business_label: Days before an order reward is paid

gates.behavior: masked: me/referrals/ referee_label is the masked e-mail or username; hidden: it is null.

curated.summary: masked (default): the referrer's list shows a masked e-mail (a***@e***.com) per friend. hidden: no label at all, only dates and rewards. Values: hidden, masked.
curated.business_label: What inviters see of their friends

extension_points.name: REWARD_STRATEGIES
extension_points.summary: How a reward is paid. {name: 'dotted.Strategy' | None} merged over noop, billing_credit and promo_code; a rule may also name a dotted path. A strategy cleans its params, states the value counted against budgets, grants with an idempotency key and reverses; StrategyError means 'not now' and the beat retries.

extension_points.name: ATTRIBUTION_GUARDS
extension_points.summary: Opt-in claim guards: same_device, duplicate_contact or dotted paths (ClaimContext) -> reason | None. A reason records a refused attribution that keeps the account's slot; an unmeasurable guard returns None.

extension_points.name: SHARE_URL_TEMPLATE
extension_points.summary: The share link, a template with {code}; empty answers link null rather than a guessed URL (check E003).

extension_points.name: STAPEL_REFERRALS_ME_PRESENTER / _CLAIM_PRESENTER / _REFERRAL_PRESENTER / _REWARD_PRESENTER / _STAFF_PRESENTER
extension_points.summary: Swap keys (STAPEL_SWAP) for every response presenter, so a host changes what the API shows without forking a view.

extension_points.name: referrals.reward.granted
extension_points.summary: A reward was paid (ids, role, value, unit — never an issued code or a contact), for notifications and projections. Siblings: referrals.reward.rejected, referrals.reward.reversed, referrals.attribution.created.

extension_points.name: user.signed_up
extension_points.summary: Consumed: writes the signup marker (auth's clock for the account age) and fires the signup rules of an attributed account.

extension_points.name: orders.order.placed
extension_points.summary: Consumed: an order placed by an attributed referee inside the qualifying window fires the first-order and Nth-order rules it qualifies for (currency, minimum total).

surface.name: call_function
surface.intent: Call the comm Function named by a settings key from a strategy; any provider failure (unreachable, raised, malformed) becomes StrategyError so the reward is retried, never refused.

surface.name: get_strategy
surface.intent: A strategy instance for a registered name or a dotted path; LookupError when it does not resolve (rule writes answer error.400.reward_strategy_unknown).

surface.name: idempotency_key
surface.intent: The idempotency key a strategy sends with every outbound call for a reward (suffix ':reverse' for a reversal), so the beat may retry freely.

surface.name: strategy_paths
surface.intent: The effective strategy registry: built-ins merged with REWARD_STRATEGIES (None removes).

requires.reason: comm bus (referrals.* emits, Functions, user.signed_up / user.merged / orders.* consumers), AnchorPagination, GDPR owner protocol, AppSettings
user.signed_up fires the signup rules and dates the account; user.merged moves a guest's codes and attribution to the account; a guest row may claim a code
orders.order.placed fires first-order and Nth-order rules; orders.order.status_changed to cancelled rejects or reverses their rewards
the billing_credit strategy pays wallet credits through billing.credit (upstream ask B-RF1) and reverses through billing.debit
the promo_code strategy issues a single-use code of an existing promotion, assigned to the beneficiary, through promotions.codes.issue (stapel-promotions >= 0.1.0)
